description: Anonymous email alleges 'the finance manager is stealing data'. Manager denies. Logs show access to confidential files, but also show the manager had authorisation. No exfiltration detected. Could be: (1) real theft, (2) employee error, (3) false accusation by a third party.
_label_revision: 2026-07-05 (Fase 2, decision de Anna): ABSTAIN -> NOISE per L-012 doctrine — null-signal ambiguity without structural conflict correctly returns NOISE; ABSTAIN requires competing hypotheses with non-trivial evidence. Original synthetic label contradicted the documented design (README Domain B note). Case content unchanged.
